test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Ankit went to Manali, for river rafting. He rows at the rate of 12 km/h in still water. To cover the same distance, it takes him twice as long to row up as to row down the river. Find the rate of flow of the river.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Time** (Upstream : Downstream) = 2 : 1

Since **Distance** is constant, **Speed** ratio is inverse of Time ratio: (U : D) = 1 : 2

Speed in **Still Water** (u) : Speed of **Stream** (v) = (D + U) : (D − U) = (2 + 1) : (2 − 1) = 3 : 1

Given 3 units = 12 km/h ⇒ 1 unit = 12 ÷ 3 = 4 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 4 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed in **still water** (u) = 12 km/h

Let the **rate of flow** of the river (v) = x km/h

Time taken to row **upstream** = 2 × Time taken to row **downstream**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0b5ade9511d3a2d0d8fa654e0069ea6eb81295c9c86b61d5cde280baab4249f.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Downstream Speed** = u + v

**Upstream Speed** = u − v

**Calculations:**

Let the distance be D km.

⇒ D ÷ (12 − x) = 2 × (D ÷ (12 + x))

⇒ 1 ÷ (12 − x) = 2 ÷ (12 + x)

⇒ 12 + x = 2 × (12 − x)

⇒ 12 + x = 24 − 2x

⇒ x + 2x = 24 − 12

⇒ 3x = 12

⇒ x = 4 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 4 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream and Upstream Concepts

When a boat moves with the flow of the river, it is **Downstream** (Speed = u + v). When it moves against the flow, it is **Upstream** (Speed = u − v).

Speed of Still Water and Stream

Still water speed (u) = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2. Stream speed (v) = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

Ratio Relationship

If time taken to travel a distance upstream is **n** times the time taken downstream, then u/v = (n + 1) / (n − 1).</p
